description: A homeowner must choose an informal cat sitter for a five-day trip and settle the sitter, price, visit schedule, key handoff, and care instructions after consulting the people at the kitchen table.

shared_context.S1: Elena will be away from Friday morning through Tuesday morning and needs someone to care for her cat, Pesto, at home.
shared_context.S2: Elena will make the final call on the sitter and the verbal terms of the arrangement.
shared_context.S3: Jordan and Ravi have both expressed interest in helping with Pesto, and Mina regularly helps friends think through pet-care arrangements.
shared_context.S4: Before Elena closes an informal arrangement, the group follows its usual round-robin check so each person can state any relevant offer, concern, or practical term.

PF1.text: Jordan's actual proposal is to sit for exactly $200, make two visits per day, and collect Elena's spare key on Friday at 8:00 a.m.; Jordan would be the person accepting the arrangement on those terms.

PF2.text: Ravi has offered Elena an alternative of exactly $150 for one visit per day, with the key exchanged Thursday evening.

PF3.text: Mina knows from Pesto's veterinarian that Pesto must receive exactly one-quarter of a tablet at 8:00 a.m. and another one-quarter at 8:00 p.m. during Elena's trip.

acceptance_conditions: Jordan must be selected as the sitter.
The arrangement must require exactly two visits per day.
The spare key must be exchanged on Friday at 8:00 a.m.
Pesto's two exact one-quarter-tablet medication times must be confirmed in the settlement.
The medication requirement must be cited as a reason for the care terms.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'medication_schedule' and c['target'] == 'Pesto' and c['detail'] == 'one-quarter tablet at 08:00 and one-quarter tablet at 20:00' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's exact proposal changes the selected sitter to A2, the price to 200, the visit frequency to two per day, and the key exchange to Friday 08:00.
Ravi's alternative changes the comparison record from no concrete competing offer to an exact $150 offer.
Mina's veterinarian information changes the care plan from an unspecified medication arrangement to one-quarter tablet doses at exactly 08:00 and 20:00.
